subject: Desktop app crashes on startup after update
body: Since this morning's update the desktop app closes immediately after the splash screen. Reinstalling did not help.

precedents.subject: App crashes after update
precedents.answer_snippet: Updating to the latest version and restarting the application resolved the crash. If it persists, we ask for the app version and a screenshot of the error.

precedents.subject: Sync not working on desktop client
precedents.answer_snippet: Signing out and back in rebuilt the local cache and sync resumed.

precedents.subject: Installation schlägt unter Windows fehl
precedents.answer_snippet: Die Installation lief durch, nachdem der Kunde das Installationsprogramm als Administrator gestartet hatte.
